title: Pixel Hop
description: Tap to jump over the blocks. Music and an online leaderboard.

title: Leviathan Voyage
description: Wake up in the hangar shack, start her up and fly the AP-7 airship over an endless land. Walk her decks. Best full screen with a controller.

title: Studio 3D
description: Walk around a music studio and play it: drum machine, two synths with their sequencers, a master panel, all cabled up. Play alone, or JAM ONLINE: share a room code and make one song together. Mouse looks around on a computer; stick, drag and A / Y on a phone.

title: Tussen de Linies
description: Jij bent De Tolk op het oefenterrein: Nederlandse instructeurs, Oekraïense trainees. Sta op tijd bij wie praat, onthoud het en kies de juiste vertaling. Praten er twee tegelijk? Steek je hand op. Solo (5 dagen) of samen met 2-4 tolken.

title: MApP
description: The 150 m around you, rebuilt from OpenStreetMap as a glitchy low-poly neon city. Walk it first person, ride a light bike (AUTO rides on your GPS), film it from a helicopter. Players within 200 m see each other; open the map, pick one and teleport over. Best as a full screen app.

title: Mistwalkers
description: Walk misty, rainy pine woods with up to three explorers. Jam lo-fi together (drum machine, synth, e-piano, guitar, flute, sax) and the fog lifts around you. Campfire, tent, coffee, chat and a voice intercom. Same camp name = same walk.

title: Туса У Берліні
description: Vika, Vito en Oleksiy: drie vrienden, één café in Berlijn. Fly, drive or take the train to Hoongy and hang out together.

title: Вгадай що?!
description: Телешоу! Pick a season and episode, one asks, the others type an answer and race to the green button. Vika, Vito, Oleksiy and anyone else.

title: Pixel Party
description: Multiplayer test: make a room, share the code and walk around together.

title: Pixel Wall
description: One shared wall for everyone. Paint pixels and watch others draw live.

title: Error-Chat
description: Text chat. Make a channel code, share it, and everyone with the same code talks together. Own on-screen keyboard.

title: pocket.DOS
description: A tiny ERROR-DOS for an ESP32 screen board: NEON FLIGHT, ERROR-CHAT and one-button games, on a 3D menu. Play them here, or on the board itself: it loads them from this page over WiFi.

title: Home Front
description: Screens at home: an ESP32-S3 board (or any browser at /thuisfront/dev) shows one web app, you control it from your phone. First app COMM: big text in any font and animation, and live video in DOS green, yellow, blue or gray. Screen off, close, and it keeps your text after a restart.

title: ERROR-CUBE
description: The ERROR-DOS cube (Waveshare ESP32-S3 2.16in AMOLED): your cubes, their settings, live video and sound from your phone, web apps to open on them, and new firmware.
